parts.target: A **SHADOW LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES** unit of yours, a **SHADOW LEGION LEGIONES DAEMONICA** unit of yours, or one of each, provided none is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy units.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** A **SHADOW LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES** unit of yours, a **SHADOW LEGION LEGIONES DAEMONICA** unit of yours, or one of each, provided none is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy units.

**Effect:** Take those units off the battlefield and put them in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).
